phrases.text: 00:00. New date. Same soil.
Four zeroes. Four seeds. No rush to sprout.
Midnight. A fresh page. I brought a leaf.
01:23. One step at a time. Mine involve roots.
One, two, three. Already further than one.
01:23. Seeds do not skip the small part.
05:20. A small fond thought. Leaf-sized.
5:20. I like this company. Back to being grass now.
05:20. Kindness can be quiet. I have the equipment.
08:08. Grass online. No visible change.
08:08. Open for slow greening.
Two eights look ready. I will unfold one leaf.
09:09. Keeping at it. Quietly. Like roots.
Two nines. Slow growth still has somewhere to go.
09:09. Steady does not need a progress bar.
11:11. Four stems. Plant a wish between them.
Four ones. I wish for softer soil. Specific, I know.
11:11. Plant the wish. No need to dig it up and check yet.
12:34. In order. I am not built for queue-jumping.
One, two, three, four. Roots first. Fancy shape later.
12:34. A small next step is still next.
13:14. No long speech. Just a little company.
13:14. Forever sounds tall. I will grow through today first.
It's 13:14. Company need not be talkative. Exhibit A: grass.
5:20 PM. A little fondness. Planted right here.
17:20. Nice having you nearby. Not a photosynthesis thing.
Evening 5:20. A small confession. Leaves cannot blush.
20:20. Looking back. Some growth was underground.
Two twenties. Small good things deserve a second look.
20:20. Today's review: green. That counts as an entry.
22:22. Double rest. No double effort required to earn it.
Four twos. Both leaves may relax at the same time.
22:22. Two beats slower. Conveniently, my usual speed.
23:59. One minute. Enough room for a breath.
A minute to tomorrow. Unsprouted is not the same as failed.
23:59. The rest can keep growing tomorrow.
